description: Renovate configuration for server-config. Auto-merge policy approved by Engineering Lead (ENG-POLICY-042). Rationale: manual dependency review was creating 2-3 week merge backlogs, and 94% of PRs were approved without changes. Auto-merge with test gates provides equivalent safety with significantly reduced toil.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge all patch and minor updates. These are backward-compatible by semver contract. 94% approval rate on manual review (ENG-POLICY-042 appendix A).

Auto-merge major updates after CI passes. Major version bumps had 89% approval rate in the last 6 months. The few breaking changes were caught by our test suite, not by manual review. Holding majors for review just adds latency without improving safety (ENG-POLICY-042 section 3.2).
Pin Docker digests for reproducible builds
